messages:
neal_sales: Hey product — FinWave wants us to onboard `trident-14b-open` v2.0 and pin it in EU (frankfurt) + APAC (singapore). They asked for 4-bit quantized variant and model residency for their regulated payroll data. Any blockers? :wave:
marta_product: Thanks Neal. Quick clarifying q's: 1) expected steady qps / burst? 2) latency SLO (95th)? 3) Dedicated required or is hosted with geo-route ok?
neal_sales: They expect low-volume steady 5 qps, peak up to 30 qps. 95th target <= 300ms. Prefer Hosted with geo-route but may require Dedicated if we can't guarantee isolation.
anya_mlops: Notes: trident-14b has community weights but no official quantized artifacts in repo. We'll need to run quantization pipeline (4-bit) + regression tests. Licensing looks permissive (MIT-like fork) per customer attachment. Could take 3-5 infra days if kernels need tuning.
chris_infra: For EU+APAC pinning we need: 1) model artifacts in region (s3 replication) 2) KMS keys per region for logs/embeddings 3) routing rule + capacity reservation. If Hosted can enforce region-only routing, no Dedicated slot needed. Also confirm customer wants model version pinning (v2.0) vs auto-updates.
neal_sales: They require strict v2.0 pin (no auto-updates). Will sign data residency annex.
marta_product: Launch acceptance checklist proposal: - staging perf run with their sample prompt set (95th <= 300ms at 5qps) - quantized artifact verified (bit-exact-ish, no hallucination regressions on our eval set) - region replication + KMS provisioning - billing tier confirmed + MSA + data annex - security review complete
anya_mlops: I'll start a quantization smoke and run our regression suite. If we hit kernel issues, estimate +2 dev days.
devex_bot: Intake created: INTK-7890. Please attach model tarball, license, test prompts, and billing contact.
onboard_bot: Onboard ticket ONB-3102 created and set to priority: P3. Owner: unassigned.
marta_product: Proposal: add to backlog under "customer-onboardings/apac-eu-pinning" and mark as customer-driven. Assign owner before sprint planning next Wed.
neal_sales: FinWave wants a pilot in APAC within 4 weeks. They can provide test prompts after MSA.
marta_product: I'll grab ownership for product rollout. @anya_mlops can you post perf numbers and any blockers to INTK-7890 by EOD Friday?
anya_mlops: Yep — will post results. If artifacts are clean we can aim for pilot timeline, otherwise I'll flag blockers early.
chris_infra: I'll prepare regional replication checklist and estimate infra hours in the ticket.
